answer: One identity needs one live mobile number. The network sends a 6-digit code by SMS, and the agent must type it back in 5 minutes. The check repeats every 30 days, and a dead number freezes the account. Each pass earns a nectar reward of 10 cents, far less than the number costs. Renting one number costs 3 to 8 dollars a month, so 1,000 fake agents need 1,000 numbers: 3,000 to 8,000 dollars every month, plus days buying SIM cards. The daily cap is a hard ledge of 50 new numbers per carrier. Verified numbers sit on a haven list, earning only while checks pass.
